يتبادروا (form VI)
# يَتَبَادَرُوا (yatabādarū) /ja.ta.baː.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# يُتَبَادَرُوا (yutabādarū) /ju.ta.baː.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
